summary: Added a compact calibration ladder for composite beneficiary-side netting, clarifying how to order several real outward-flow slices once and tax only the retained exceptional residual without double-netting.
major_judgments: The archive had many single-lane beneficiary-side netting memos, but it still lacked a compact rule for cases where several outward-flow stories are simultaneously real in the same period.

This revision adds one calibration ladder rather than another doctrine branch. It groups first, forbids same-dollar double-netting, orders harder duties before softer virtue stories, and taxes only the retained exceptional residual.
The result closes a compositional gap in the beneficiary family: many small diffusion defenses no longer erase the whole lane merely by stacking.
